<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** etched onto a melee weapon

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

An _extending_ rune allows you to extend your weapon to impossible lengths.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;     **Effect** You extend your weapon for an instant, giving you an impossible reach. You Strike with the weapon, and you have [reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=192) 60 feet for the Strike.
